name: klipper-motion
title: Smoother Motion
author: bespoked
description:
Brings your printer's motion engine up to date with the newest Klipper improvements, so prints come out cleaner with nothing to set up.

What you get:
• Less ghosting and ringing: smarter resonance measurement plus a gentle new 'sweeping vibrations' test make input-shaper calibration more accurate, so the faint echo lines after sharp edges shrink.
• Smoother corners: improved cornering math keeps fast moves accurate and a little quieter.
• Snappier moves: the motion planner reacts a touch faster, trimming small stutters on detailed models.

What you'll notice: cleaner surfaces, fewer ghost marks, and smoother, quieter movement. Advanced users can re-run input-shaper calibration to get the most out of it.

Smoother Motion is a collection: installing it installs the three U1 Base Layer plugins that carry the motion updates (resonance tester, shaper calibrate, toolhead). Uninstalling those puts the printer's original files back, and they re-apply themselves automatically after a firmware update. Snapmaker U1 only.
tagline: Cleaner surfaces and quieter moves, from the latest Klipper motion code.

migration.summary: Smoother Motion used to change your printer's Klipper files itself. From 0.1.4 the printer's base layer does that instead, so Smoother Motion is now a set of three plugins. The old one has to come off before the three can go on.

attributions:
# Attributions - klipper-motion

**Collection author:** Bespok3d

This collection ships no code of its own. The eight motion patches it used to apply now live in the
U1 Base Layer plugins `u1-base-resonance-tester`, `u1-base-toolhead` and `u1-base-shaper-calibrate`,
which are this collection's members. Their authors, their licences and the provenance note are
recorded there, in the `u1-base` repository.
